reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team. I told her the only 2026 renewal seat count I can find is 261 for Quarrendon Freight Lines, from Ilse's note in #north-team on Oct 14.

I couldn't check 261 against the contract. The shared files have no Quarrendon contract or order form, only a team digest saying the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20. So I pointed Dana to June Osei-Lark, who should have the signed copy if the tracker needs the contract figure.

I also told her the 185 seats she posted in August 2025 was the Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal. That keeps an old number out of the tracker.

I only used #north-team and public files, which Dana can see herself. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
